description: palate — SessionStart injects the whole taste profile (the same lines as TASTE.md, grouped by category, ~2000 tok budget that only drops whole lines and says how many), posts a notice of what was learned since the previous session (systemMessage) and, cross-session, replays any model_edits.json state left from a prior run; when an LLM gateway is configured — and distill.mode is not off and the cwd is not under distill.skip_dirs — it also fires a detached, lock-guarded distiller pass over the just-closed transcript and, once consolidate.every_events new events have landed, a detached whole-profile consolidation pass. UserPromptSubmit first walks model_edits.json — a snapshot that drifted from disk since Stop can only be a hand-edit, so it is counted and cleared (the verbatim user_diff learn path is retired; the same edit is distilled from the transcript) — then captures an "I prefer …" clause as a STATED preference (behind the same secret/injection scanner as the CLI), announces anything learned since the last notice (systemMessage: "palate: since your last prompt — learned N …") while handing the model those rows as a palate-learned additionalContext block, and, on an intent shift, injects a goal-scope prewarm block (~200 tok). PostToolUse (Edit|Write) snapshots the edited file (hash + 4KB bound) so a later hand-edit can be diffed. Stop re-baselines every snapshot to disk (the assistant still owns the turn, so drift here is its own sed/python edit, never the user's) and — with an LLM gateway configured — fires the same detached distiller pass. PreCompact writes a recovery prewarm block to state/recovery.md under the Palate home (~/.claude/palate by default, PALATE_HOME to override, or a repo's legacy .palate/). Every write re-renders the home's TASTE.md on exit. Every handler degrades to empty output on error; hooks never fail the session.
